scenario: Select an eligible body containing multiple formerly hidden symbionts.

expected: Each strict outcome and OE delta follows Q-SYM-074/CQA-019 once; equality expels and blocks same-turn retry; replay is idempotent.
scenario: Resolve greater, lower and equal current-OE cases, including stale revision and reconnect.

expected: One fitting saved species is reserved per win with fixed random receipt; pause preserves state; finalization irreversibly discards only unrecovered templates.
scenario: Win one duel, tie another, pause for OE recovery, resume, leave a resident symbiont and finalize.

expected: The completed event automatically and atomically updates rewards/history/count/slot once without GM confirmation; interruption gives no history or reward.
scenario: Complete one app-run Devouring, replay its receipt, then interrupt another before completion.

expected: GM sees the three intervals and sums; player sees only count/history/open slots and never threshold values or distance to next threshold.
scenario: Compare player and GM projections before and after every threshold crossing.

expected: The first external event increments once; duplicate and app-runtime receipt produce zero write.
scenario: Record a proven external event twice and attempt to submit an app-runtime receipt through the GM form.

expected: Each row shows only known identity, seven characteristics, alive/available/offMap/currentHP and infection status; no coordinate, maxHP, inventory or unrelated hidden effect leaks.
scenario: Monitor known, unknown, on-map, off-map, alive, dead and unavailable infected targets across revision changes.

expected: MON-049 is present in the PLY-035 signed AbilityID/availableAction allowlist and opens the combat chooser only while legal; a failed or stale predicate removes the action from payload, DOM, a11y, hotkeys and cache without losing the monitoring row.
scenario: For an infected off-map target evaluate MON-049 ('Вы больны…') first with all ability predicates true, then with one predicate false, after a revision change and after reconnect.

expected: Active assistants are removed once without action/OE cost; a separate disease and completed effect remain; stale/foreign IDs change nothing.
scenario: Destroy assistants free/out-of-turn after another action declaration and after an effect has already fully resolved.

expected: The player sees the observer-safe own marker or explicit unknown state and safely returns to PLY-001; GM-only notes/markers never leak.
scenario: In peace open own location with a known marker, then with hidden/unknown location and after reconnect.

expected: Exactly one branch is available: VISIBLE with a current marker opens MAP-006; UNKNOWN/HIDDEN with a null marker projection opens MAP-007 and exposes no correlatable coordinate or marker metadata.
scenario: Evaluate the known-marker and unknown/hidden-marker branches at the same revision and after a visibility change.

expected: Exactly one append-only version and receipt commit without gameplay delta; replay returns it and stale/post-roll submissions write nothing.

expected: Only the application system handler commits a valid completion and publishes its receipt; no completion CTA or GM confirmation exists, while the ordinary combat declaration remains available through MON-004.
scenario: Complete and interrupt app-run Devouring while inspecting actions, system events and GM controls.

expected: Every EXECUTE binding is reachable through an explicit command; preparation/projection forms cannot impersonate execution.
scenario: Enumerate every executable operation and locate its typed CTA, required payload, guards, commit receipt and reconnect path.

expected: The common witness and formula proof survive end to end; no weapon instance is created before GM resolution and an idempotent receipt.
scenario: Submit a validated custom weapon request, admit its campaign copy and resolve it as GM, including stale and rejected variants.

expected: Mass/anatomy/composition and monster physics are complete; category, melee distance and cost=1 are fixed, while unsupported range/hit/targeting/custom-cost fields are rejected.
scenario: Create a sentient enemy and arbitrary monster, then attempt unsupported monster attack fields.

expected: Bleeding/burning commit once; excluded effect types are absent from the selectable allowlist and rejected before write.
scenario: Apply bleeding and burning through their typed forms, then try to add trace-only, orphaned, derived and source-owned container effects through GM-014.
